Ye's knockout script (default --step all) also re-runs 5-core filtering and an unseeded split into each knockout directory; we deliberately keep OUR fixed split so runs pair by seed with the existing full run (not replicated).

Graph builder differs from Ye's MMRec FREEDOM (MKF4MMRec src/models/freedom.py:79-99): theirs is a DIRECTED top-k incl. the item itself, D^-1/2 A D^-1/2 with row degrees = k, i.e. every row sums to 1 and a hub cannot inflate any row; ours (Recsys graph_utils.build_knn_graph) excludes self, SYMMETRIZES max(A, A^T) and normalizes by the symmetrized degree, so a noise hub item gets a high-degree row. We keep our harness's builder for every condition (so conditions pair), which means the noise graph is recipe-faithful but not graph-builder-faithful to Ye.
MMRec FREEDOM caches mm_adj_freedomdsp_{k}_{w}.pt in the dataset dir and reloads it if present; our harness rebuilds the graph from the passed features every run (no cache).

Ye's knockout script (default --step all) also re-runs 5-core filtering and an unseeded split into each knockout directory; we deliberately keep OUR fixed split so runs pair by seed with the existing full run (not replicated).

Graph builder differs from Ye's MMRec FREEDOM (MKF4MMRec src/models/freedom.py:79-99): theirs is a DIRECTED top-k incl. the item itself, D^-1/2 A D^-1/2 with row degrees = k, i.e. every row sums to 1 and a hub cannot inflate any row; ours (Recsys graph_utils.build_knn_graph) excludes self, SYMMETRIZES max(A, A^T) and normalizes by the symmetrized degree, so a noise hub item gets a high-degree row. We keep our harness's builder for every condition (so conditions pair), which means the noise graph is recipe-faithful but not graph-builder-faithful to Ye.
MMRec FREEDOM caches mm_adj_freedomdsp_{k}_{w}.pt in the dataset dir and reloads it if present; our harness rebuilds the graph from the passed features every run (no cache).

recipe.distribution: Normal(mean=1.0, sd=0.1) i.i.d. per item and dimension
recipe.draw_order: text (384-d) drawn first, then image (4096-d), same stream
recipe.dtype: float64 as generated; cast to float32 by MultimodalRecommender (.float())
recipe.fixed: generated once per run, used unchanged for training and inference; never resampled
recipe.where_it_enters: replaces the modality's feature tensor passed to FREEDOM: its kNN graph (kept at the original mixing weight) and the trainable nn.Embedding.from_pretrained init of its auxiliary BPR branch
ambiguities: Paper text says only 'Gaussian noise'; mean 1 / sd 0.1 come from the released code.
Ye's seed is the constant 42 for every run/model; per the task this run derives the noise seed from the run seed unless --noise-seed-mode ye42.
